text: A man does not like to prove such a truth; Byron excepted from the category, jealousy. “And prove the very truth he most abhorred.” He saw my hesitation, and spoke:-- “The logic is simple, no madman’s logic this time, jumping from tussock to tussock in a misty bog. If it be not true, then proof will be relief; at worst it will not harm. If it be true! Ah, there is the dread; yet very dread should help my cause, for in it is some need of belief.
